description: This file defines the CursorStatement class, which extends AbstractCursorHandler to manage database cursor operations, including executing queries, handling result sets, and transaction management within JDBC context.

classes.name: CursorStatement
classes.description: A class that manages JDBC cursor operations, including executing queries, fetching results, and handling transaction boundaries.

methods.name: CursorStatement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cursor handling, begins a transaction, and manages auto-commit settings.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method calls dynamically for cursor operations such as close, executeQuery, getMoreResults, getResultSet, and cursor configuration.

methods.name: newCursorStatement
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CursorStatement wrapped as a Statement.

methods.name: newCursorPreparedStatement
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CursorStatement wrapped as a PreparedStatement.
